content.title: Everything to Know About The Voice Season 29 Finale
content.text: From the Blind Auditions all the way to the two-night Finale event, The Voice: Battle of Champions has been a journey. A journey full of shocking surprises, breathtaking performances, and so many memorable moments from Season 29 veteran Coaches Kelly Clarkson, John Legend, and Adam Levine. And, believe it or not, The Voice will soon reveal its next winner. Very soon. How to WatchAs the Coaches have officially narrowed down their teams to just three Artists each, the winning title of The Voice is truly anyone's game, as Levine told NBC Insider in a press junket ahead of Season 29's premiere. "There's three people, one on each team, that I do genuinely believe could win this thing," the Maroon 5 frontman and OG Voice Coach teased. RELATED: Stream New Episodes of The Voice: Battle of Champions the Next Day on PeacockThe Voice: Battle of Champions is about to come to a close, so read on for everything you need to know to watch the action as it happens on NBC. The Voice Season 29 Finale will take place during an action-packed two-night event. The Voice Season 29 Semi-Finals first air on Monday, April 13, at 9/8c on NBC and will reveal the Top 4 Artists heading to the Finale. The next day, The Voice: Battle of Champions Finale airs on Tuesday, April 14, at 9/8c on NBC. RELATED: The Voice Season 29: The Ultimate Episode-by-Episode Guide for Super FansWhere can you watch The Voice Season 29 Finale?You can watch the two-night Finale event for The Voice: Battle of Champions right on NBC or the next day on Peacock,Both episodes of The Voice — airing on April 13 and April 14 — begin at 9/8c and will each run two hours. RELATED: How CeeLo Green Literally Had Tricks Up His Sleeve on The Voice: "He's a Wild Man"Who are The Voice Artists going to the Semi-Finals?Here are The Voice Season 29's Top 9 Artists heading to the Semi-Finals: Team Kelly JW GriffinLiv CiaraMikenley BrownTeam Legend Lucas WestSyd MillevoiKJ WillisTeam AdamAlexia JayyJeremy KeithJared ShoemakerAfter the Semi-Finals on Monday night, there will only be four Artists heading to the Finale on April 14, which will be decided by an in-studio vote. While Legend and Levine will both bring one Artist each from their teams, Clarkson can bring two after winning the All-Star Showdown, a brand new competition that brought back former Voice winners and stars to compete on their Coach's behalf.RELATED: Why Jennifer Hudson's Shoe Went Flying on The Voice: "This Is What I'm Talking About!"Who votes for the winner of The Voice Season 29?An in-studio audience! Voting for the next winner of The Voice will happen differently this time around. For this season of The Voice, there's a brand new voting system where the in-studio audience comprised of former Voice Artists and super fans will vote for their favorite Artists in real-time. The Voice Host Carson Daly will then reveal the results. "It's in-house voting, it's live voting," Clarkson explained to NBC Insider in a press junket with her fellow Coaches, adding that she believes the in-person aspect, rather than watching televised performances, "is going to change everything.""We've never seen it before," Legend added. "It'll be like a little scientific experiment ... because it'll be very different from America voting." RELATED: Why Kelly Clarkson Was Moved to Tears on The Voice: "It's Why I Love..."When will the winner of The Voice Season 29 be announced?The winner of The Voice Season 29 will be announced during the two-hour Finale episode on Tuesday, April 14. Tune in at 9/8c on NBC so you don't miss a second of the action!
